question: What transformation of the body is claimed after the veil of ignorance is struck away?
premises: The speaker refers to their own body
The body was struck by the veil of ignorance
The body is now described as pure
inference: The speaker claims that their body, once struck by ignorance, is now pure.
uncertainties: The compound may imply removal of the veil rather than ongoing affliction.
plain_english: Today my body, once struck by the veil of ignorance, is pure.
